exposure: implementation of Power Chart Maternity Care4 (PCM) electronic charting method
outcome: compliance with antibiotic prophylaxis administration timing
cohort: The study included women undergoing scheduled cesarean births at Children's Memorial Hermann Hospital Women's Services.
finding: The new quality improvement process resulted in 99% compliance with antibiotic prophylaxis administration within the one-hour window prior to incision, narrowly missing the 100% goal.
mod_finding: The quality improvement initiative specifically aimed to improve the timing of antibiotic prophylaxis for scheduled cesarean births, achieving 99% compliance with the evidence-based guidelines.
